scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- State Tracking for Toggles
local Toggles = {
    Convert = false,
    Claim = false,
    Upgrade = false
}

-- Create Main ScreenGui
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "CashMenuGui"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Top-Right Reopen UI Button (for when main frame is closed)
local OpenCloseBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
OpenCloseBtn.Name = "OpenCloseButton"
OpenCloseBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 30)
OpenCloseBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -90, 0, 10)
OpenCloseBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 45)
OpenCloseBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
OpenCloseBtn.Text = "Toggle UI"
OpenCloseBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
OpenCloseBtn.TextSize = 14
OpenCloseBtn.Parent = ScreenGui

local ToggleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
ToggleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
ToggleCorner.Parent = OpenCloseBtn

-- Main Menu Frame
local Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
Frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 210)
Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -110, 0.4, -105)
Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 30)
Frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
Frame.Active = true
Frame.Draggable = true
Frame.Parent = ScreenGui

local FrameCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
FrameCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
FrameCorner.Parent = Frame

-- Red Cross (X) Close Button
local CloseCrossBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
CloseCrossBtn.Name = "CloseCrossBtn"
CloseCrossBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 24, 0, 24)
CloseCrossBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -29, 0, 5)
CloseCrossBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 40, 40)
CloseCrossBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
CloseCrossBtn.Text = "X"
CloseCrossBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
CloseCrossBtn.TextSize = 14
CloseCrossBtn.Parent = Frame

local CrossCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
CrossCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
CrossCorner.Parent = CloseCrossBtn

-- Title
local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35)
Title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Title.Text = "CASH AUTO MENU"
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
Title.TextSize = 16
Title.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
Title.Parent = Frame

-- Layout
local UIListLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
UIListLayout.Parent = Frame
UIListLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
UIListLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
UIListLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 10)

-- Helper to Create Buttons
local function createToggleButton(name, text, layoutOrder)
    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    button.Name = name
    button.Size = UDim2.new(0, 190, 0, 40)
    button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55)
    button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
    button.Text = text .. " [OFF]"
    button.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansSemibold
    button.TextSize = 14
    button.LayoutOrder = layoutOrder
    button.Parent = Frame

    local btnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    btnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    btnCorner.Parent = button

    return button
end

local ConvertBtn = createToggleButton("ConvertCash", "Auto Convert Cash", 1)
local ClaimBtn = createToggleButton("ClaimCash", "Auto Claim Cash", 2)
local UpgradeBtn = createToggleButton("UpgradeCash", "Auto Upgrade Cash", 3)

-- Close Button (Red X) Click Logic
CloseCrossBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    Frame.Visible = false
end)

-- Reopen UI Button Click Logic
OpenCloseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    Frame.Visible = not Frame.Visible
end)

-- Handle Toggle Visuals and Auto Loops
local function setupToggle(button, toggleKey, baseText, actionCallback)
    button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        Toggles[toggleKey] = not Toggles[toggleKey]

        if Toggles[toggleKey] then
            button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(46, 139, 87)
            button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            button.Text = baseText .. " [ON]"

            task.spawn(function()
                while Toggles[toggleKey] do
                    actionCallback()
                    task.wait(1)
                end
            end)
        else
            button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55)
            button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
            button.Text = baseText .. " [OFF]"
        end
    end)
end

-- 1. Auto Convert Cash Logic
setupToggle(ConvertBtn, "Convert", "Auto Convert Cash", function()
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        local Event = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("LaunderingRemotes"):WaitForChild("RequestLaunder")
        Event:FireServer("WashingMachine")
    end)
    if not success then
        warn("Convert error:", err)
    end
end)

-- 2. Auto Claim Cash Logic
setupToggle(ClaimBtn, "Claim", "Auto Claim Cash", function()
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        local Event = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PrinterRemotes"):WaitForChild("RequestAction")
        Event:FireServer("RustyPrinter", "Claim")
    end)
    if not success then
        warn("Claim error:", err)
    end
end)

-- 3. Auto Upgrade Cash Logic
setupToggle(UpgradeBtn, "Upgrade", "Auto Upgrade Cash", function()
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        local Event = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PrinterRemotes"):WaitForChild("RequestAction")
        Event:FireServer("RustyPrinter", "Upgrade")
    end)
    if not success then
        warn("Upgrade error:", err)
    end
end)
